skillFull: After collecting enough Bear Jellies, the Cookie throws its teddy bear ahead to create an animated Teddy Bear. The Teddy Bear can be either Yellow, Pink, or Light Blue, and each skill activation cycles between each color. The Teddy Bear runs toward the right, creating Lollipop Jellies at certain intervals. Level Up for more points for Lollipop Jellies. (The blessing of the Teddy Bears also increases the duration of Yellow, Pink, and Frozen Bear Jelly Party Items by 50%, and you gain Magnetic Aura for Yellow, Pink, Blue, and Giant Bear Jellies.)
story:
The winter holidays truly are a time filled with miracles! On a particular day, a certain Cookie shopkeeper found a doll buried in the snow and took it back to the shop to repair it. Just as the clock turned to midnight, the Cookie inserted the wind-up key and turned it around, and this Cookie miraculously opened her eyes!

She pledged to help out with work in the shop as thanks for fixing her, but if you ask for recommendations, she just keeps bringing out her own favorite toys and starts playing with them. But how could anyone be angry after seeing that innocent smile?

After spending hours playing with the teddy bears in the shop, Lollipop Cookie suddenly stops in her tracks, just like a wind-up toy. If you ever get to see that, let's cover the Cookie with a warm blanket to help her dream only the sweetest dreams.

costumes.info: On the day of the finals in the Celestial Temple, the skies were filled with the first snow of the year! Lollipop Cookie, having looked forward to this happening all year, ran outside first of all, even before the sun had risen. With all the snowflakes almost resembling beautiful flowers, perhaps this is the way heaven congratulates the winner!

costumes.info: In the attic of the Merrybear Toy Shop, there resides a talented stitcher! On holiday eve night, toys dressed in winter clothes crafted by Lollipop Cookie wake up and start dancing to the rhythmic hum of the sewing machine. Perhaps the Cookie wishes to share the wonders of the holiday miracle she remembers receiving from one kindhearted Cookie.
